description: Dunit musl port (M6) thread: — pthreads on the Dunit kernel. userspace/ctests/musl_thread.c spawns two threads that each do 5000 contended mutex increments, joins both, and checks the total and return values. Exercises the native __clone + per-thread SetThreadPointer, the futex wait/wake dispatcher, pthread_join, and the kernel clear-child-tid primitive (SetTidAddress) that releases musl's thread-list lock on thread exit. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_thread_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 8 --cmd-timeout 60 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
two pthreads ran, a contended mutex serialized 10000 increments correctly, and both join return values propagated
pthread_create/join + mutex/futex + clear-child-tid thread exit all work through the ported libc
